svg.title: One question, two routes: a browser and headless-kit
svg.desc: Two routes to one question, has antirez starred anything new on GitHub, measured on 14 Nov 2026. Through a browser: the page of 30 repositories comes back to the agent as a snapshot of 7,136 tokens (20,481 bytes, 3.9 s), and the agent still has to compare the list with what it saw last time. Through headless-kit: one github-stars command returns one JSON line of 72 tokens (202 bytes, 0.28 s) that says nothing is new after checking 100 stars against its own record. That is 99 times less to read. The same line, recorded with a shorter file path: {"ok":true,"user":"antirez","read":100,"seeded":false,"new":[],"pushed":{"ntfy":0,"webhook":0,"failed":0},"state":"stars.json","dryRun":false}
